name: Lewisice Lidlow
original_name: ルイスアイス・リッドロウ
source: A mysterious person who claims to be the brother of Aliceforte. He often looks down on others and treats them like garbage. A skilled swordsman who can use magic. Has a twisted obsession with his younger brother.
